subject: quant

title.en: Martingale challenge: information, conditional means and stopping
title.zh: 鞅挑战：信息、条件期望与停止

en.a: Condition on information available now, using finite probability trees.
en.b: Distinguish constant means, predictable stakes, compensation and bounded stopping.

zh.a: 用有限概率树，只对当前信息下仍可能的未来取平均。
zh.b: 辨别均值不变、可预测赌注、漂移补偿与有界停止。

references: MIT 18.445 (Spring 2015): Lectures 15–17, conditional expectation and martingales
